title: Me and My Village: Youth Expression and Community Identity
excerpt: Writing, drawing, and speaking competitions helped students express pride in their villages and reflect on local development.
coverImageAlt: School students presenting essays and drawings on village life
bodyMarkdown:
## Building belonging through expression

Megh Foundation youth volunteers organized school competitions on the theme *Me and My Village* to help children connect with local culture, people, and aspirations.

## Competition formats

- Essay writing
- Drawing
- Public speaking

## Development value

These activities build confidence, communication, and identity. Children who value their roots are better prepared to become community leaders who can imagine and shape positive local change.
